name: @ever-works/hubspot-connector-plugin
description: HubSpot CRM connector plugin for Ever Works platform (outbound notes + record creation via the official @hubspot/api-client, and event-source pull of contact/company/deal changes into the event-ingest pipeline, with opt-in historical backfill)

plugin.name: HubSpot Connector
plugin.description: HubSpot CRM connector. Outbound appends notes to CRM records and creates records (contacts/companies/deals) via the official @hubspot/api-client. Event-source pull ingests records created/updated since the last watermark into the platform event-ingest pipeline, with opt-in historical backfill (backfillDays, max 90).

objectTypes.title: CRM object types to ingest (comma-separated; contacts, companies, deals when empty)

portalId.title: HubSpot portal (hub) id — enables deep links back to each record

backfillDays.title: Historical backfill window in days on first pull (0 = off, max 90)

defaultObjectType.title: Default CRM object type for record writes

defaultAssociatedObjectId.title: Default CRM record id outbound notes are attached to
